title: Two cyclic fields with carryless prefix reuse and 41 exact pair cutoffs

claims.statement: The explicit 2-field degree-500 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-113 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 5517525079880631999947027195131552510913508145243/100000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), averaged pair bounds at cutoffs 198–219 (1), pair bounds 220–238 and child removal counts through weight 238 (2), and complete occupancy and error (3). The cumulative score check uses the exact oriented proper-run bounds. Part zero also checks the wide-window cube schedule, extended RAM map and fixed-cap worst-case recurrence, with eight exact reference-counter replays. Part zero also checks prefix reuse, its fixed mode table and RAM map, and twenty exact cache replays. These replays include the carryless suffix polynomial product.
